lines.en: : Mngh?!
But she collided with something upon reaching her destination.
And even though there was a cloud of all-consuming misery swirling around her, it could not prevent the overwhelming Japanese instinct to immediately break character and apologize.
: I’m sorry! I didn’t-
: Wait, Chika? Is that you?
: No! Sorry! Wrong person! Nothing to see here! Just a selfish fucking idiot!
: Are you crying? What happened?
: Nothing! Can I just...get a few minutes please?!
: I feel like it would be very irresponsible of me to just leave you like this. Do you want to talk about it?

: Talking is what got me into this mess in the first place! So chances are if I do it again now, you’ll just throw some other horrible reveal at me in the end and remind me of how selfish I’ve become!
: Or I could...promise to not do that?
: Then I look selfish for not caring! I can’t fucking win! You just...tell me all your problems or something! I’m fine!
: You are most certainly not fine. And I really think you should try to quiet down unless you want even more people to overhear this and come swooping in to add to your discomfort.
: Why am I like this now? What happened? I used to be dependable. I had everything together. And now I just...what? Now I don’t? Why?! Where’d all of that go?!
: I don’t know you well enough to answer that, Chika...
: But I do know that Rin would kill me if I didn’t at least try to help you right now.
: So why don’t you just go on and do whatever it is you came in here to do just...with me there as well? For moral support.
: Though...it did just dawn on me where we are. So if you didn’t come in here to cry like I assumed and actually just-
: I’m obviously here to cry. Look at me. And look hard since this is what you’re going to need to put up with if you don’t take my advice and just leave right now.
: I can see you. And I’m pretty sure I can put up with it if you do want to talk.
: Hah...
: No. I don’t want to drag Rin’s boss into this too. I’ve made things hard enough on her already.
: If this is about your, uhh...encounter together, I’m already in the loop.
: You...
: Wait. You know? She told you?
: You’re not the only one struggling with stuff, you know. Rin vents to me all the-
: In there. Now.
: God, I can’t believe she told her boss! It took everything I had to tell Uta and she’s only my supervisor!
: To be fair, I’m just as much of her work-mom as I am her boss. She tells me everything whether I like it or not.
: But thankfully, I do like it. I kind of feed off of teen gossip. It keeps me feeling relevant, so this is actually kind of great for me.
: That was the first time I’ve ever done anything with a girl...I don’t even know if I did it right.
: I think it matters less if you did it correctly and more that you just did it in the first place. That must have been a big decision for you with how into Sensei you are, right?
: In hindsight, yeah. But in the moment, I...I just wanted to. It felt right.
: That’s not why I’m crying, though.
: Wait, it’s not? Then what-
: I mean, it kind of is. It’s...related to it at least. It’s just...this whole thing has distracted me from what’s really important and now I’m hurting other people too.
: God, everything would be so much easier if I was just asexual! Or even heterosexual because then all I’d have to fucking deal with is jealousy and that’s way easier than this!
: Chika...I understand where you’re coming from. I’ve also hurt people from being too focused on myself.
: You know Makoto’s mom? Well, she’s a really good friend of mine. And I wasn’t there for her when her husband died because I was too absorbed in my situation.
: It happens with Sana’s mom too. She can be very unstable and I’m not always there for her when she needs me to be. Then, when I am, I can’t really help at all.
: So I know what it’s like to be selfish. Every last bit of my existence is just selfishness at this point. There won’t be anything left to experience if you dwell on that forever, though.
: So there’s no solution? You just...have to try not to dwell on it? I can’t get better?
: I’m not a good role model, so don’t take it from me — but I’m not sure you can ever really recover from the parts of you that make you who you are.
: You’re not unwell or anything. There’s just some stuff you need to work on. And I think the fact that you’re this torn up over it makes you closer to redemption than I’ve ever been.
: Really? Do you...not get upset when people get hurt because of you?
: I do. I love my friends and I don’t ever want them to hurt.
: I just fear I’m beyond helping. And that there are parts of me I can’t ever change no matter how badly I want to change them.
: Heh...sounds familiar. Are you sleeping with Sensei too then? Did you get that from him?
: You can just admit it, Haruka. He’s the least of my problems right now. And I’ve already come to accept that he’s been screwing everyone this whole time.
: I am...
: I didn’t get that from him, though. I think I resigned myself to being a bad person the moment my husband left.
: Oh, right...you’re married too.
: That’s right. I have a husband. A husband I can’t see anymore. And I’ve been filling that void the only way I know how.
: Being lonely is terrifying. And Sensei makes me feel a little less alone sometimes. It’s as simple as that.
: So yes, I bear the mark of a traitor now. And yes, it burns. But at least I’m not afraid. Not of being alone, at least.
: And frankly, I think I’d be in the same exact situation even if it wasn’t Sensei. I think I’d have taken any man willing to put me out of my misery.
: I just lucked out and wound up with one completely lacking morals. So much so that I forget I’m cheating at all sometimes.
: That’s dark as fuck, Haruka. I don’t think I’d ever be able to cheat on someone I’m married to.
: I didn’t either until I was alone. But hey, at least I never cheated on him when he was around. So a certain somebody here has me beat in that department, at least.
: Assuming he even thinks we’re dating at all and wasn’t just going along with it to keep me from crying.
: Either way, it still hurts. And I still feel guilty about it. I just...I don’t know. I wasn’t thinking. But now thinking is all I can do.
: It’s just lately...I’ve been thinking of Rin more. That she’s the one I want to see the most. But I fucked up that chance years ago and now I have to watch as she starts to fuck Sensei too.
: Like...maybe everyone’s just selfish if we’re all going to be at each other’s throats like this? Why does our happiness always need to come at the cost of someone else’s?
: Just blame it on the dating pool. You’re all pining after the same guy, after all. I imagine things would be way less...competitive with other guys around.
: I doubt it. Almost all of us are at least a little bi. Which is why it’s so weird that more of us aren’t just dating each other to try and avoid all of this pain.
: Rin had the right idea from the start. And sometimes, I wish I accepted her confession back then. I probably wouldn’t be crying in a bathroom right now if I did, at least.
: You’re really serious about her then, huh?
: Haruka...can I ask what it is she said about me? When you guys talked about our...thing. Or would that be, like...an invasion of privacy or whatever?
: It was mostly just confusion, I think. Like, she finally resigned herself to the fact that nothing would ever happen between you guys. And then, boom. You’re the aggressor.
: No one in their right mind would know how to deal with that.
: But what if I keep being the aggressor? If I do that, do you really think I have a shot? Be honest.
: Is that what you want?
: I don’t know. But if you have a definitive answer to that question, it sure as hell might help me figure it out. I just don’t want any more regrets.
: Neither does Rin.
: And that’s exactly why I told her to follow her heart and go after Sensei instead of you.
: You did what?
: She’s had feelings for him all along. If she keeps denying those feelings in pursuit of choices she’s made before, all of which led to nothing, who’s to say anything will change?
: At least this way, she gets to try something new. And pursue a future that might make her happy with a man she’s already comfortable with.
: An adult man. Who you, another adult, told her to pursue over a girl her own age who is exponentially better for her and won’t cheat on her every opportunity she gets?
: So now age matters to you? Are you the only teenager Sensei can morally elect to sleep with? Isn’t that hypocritical, Chika?
: That’s not what I said! I just don’t get how you can call yourself her “work-mom” and then be like, “Oh, yeah! Let’s fuck the same guy! Who cares if you’re still in high school?!”
: Did Sensei get this same talk? Do you even care about age in this regard? Or are you just upset with me for not guiding Rin directly to you and it’s just easier to call me irresponsible?
: I’m upset with everything! I just figured that the majority of adults would probably side with me here given the implications of this!
: And what are the implications, exactly? That I’m a predator too?
: Well...no. That’s not what I said. But you’re, at the very least, pushing an innocent girl down an extremely immoral path that could seriously hurt her...and you’re showing no remorse at all.
: It’s like I said — I’ve already resigned myself to being a bad person. And, if we’re being honest here, I don’t see any issue with what Sensei does to you or anyone else so long as it’s consensual.
: In fact, I’d do the same thing if the opportunity presented itself.
: You...what? Hold on-
: What I’m saying is — if you need someone to cheer you up right now, the same way you cheered up Rin, I’d do it with no questions asked.
: And I’d enjoy it too. Because that’s the kind of girl I am.
: But the difference between us is that I have experience. And you wouldn’t leave this place wondering just what I am to you or where things go from here.
: You can use me, Chika.
: That’s all I’m really good for the way I am now anyway.
: Okay, bye.
: Wait! Hold on! That...okay! So, that sounded probably...way worse than I wanted it to! I just...I thought that-
: Are you fucking kidding me, Haruka?...
: You corner me in a bathroom while I’m vulnerable, pretend you actually give a shit, and then you try to fuck me? Are you seriously that pathetic?
: Yes! I am this pathetic! And I came here to cry too specifically because I felt bad about that!
: So bad that you try to fuck the first teenager you see? You expect me to believe that? Give me a fucking break. You just don’t want me to tell Rin.
: That doesn’t mean I don’t feel bad too! It’s just...why is it okay for him to do it but not me?! He’s not the only one attracted to all of you! I am too!
: If anything, you could actually try and say I’m increasing the dating pool right now! Fewer people get hurt if some of them come to me, right?!
: You have no fucking shame, do you?
: All I have is shame! But there could be so much more to give if I just...if someone loves me! I just need someone to love me! That’s it! So...please don’t tell anyone! Please!
: Un-fucking-real.
: But hey, thanks for showing me I’m not the worst person at the party after all. Weirdly enough, I actually feel a little better now.
: Please...don’t tell anyone.
: Just shut up already. You’re embarrassing yourself.
: Chika, wait!
: Touch me again and I will fucking kill you! Do you understand?!
: I’m sorry! I wasn’t trying to make things weird! That just...it works for him!
: GO. AWAY. NOW.
: Fine! Fine...
: I’ll just...um...
: I’ll...yeah! Okay! I have an idea...
